howItWorks.metaDescription: How FomaPrint works for resellers — apply, get your store account, load a balance, submit orders, and we produce and blind-ship under your brand from the USA.
howItWorks.ogDescription: Six steps from application to a blind-shipped order under your brand.
howItWorks.lead: You sell under your own brand; we personalize, produce and blind-ship every order from the USA. Here's the path from application to a package on your customer's doorstep.
howItWorks.step1Body: Tell us your store and sales channels. We review and approve.
howItWorks.step2Body: We create your seller portal account; you only see your own orders.
howItWorks.step3Body: Top up your wallet once; every order draws from the balance. No subscription, no monthly fee.
howItWorks.step4Body: Enter the order in your seller portal and upload the print file per our file specs.
howItWorks.step6Body: Sender name is your brand; the return address is our print center. Tracking flows back to you.
howItWorks.portalNote: Every order routes through your seller portal — our fulfillment workspace — from submission to blind-ship tracking, all in one place.

shipping.metaDescription: Production turnaround, white-label packaging, tracking and damage policy for FomaPrint — blind drop-shipped from the USA under your brand.
shipping.ogDescription: How FomaPrint produces, packs and blind-ships your orders.
shipping.lead: Every order is produced to order and blind-shipped from our U.S. print center — your brand on the label, never ours.
shipping.turnaroundBody: We print and ship most orders the same day — place an order before {cutoff} and it goes out that day from our US print center. Transit time is additional.
shipping.packagingBody: The package sender name is your brand. The full return address is our US print center. We never include FomaPrint branding or pricing.
shipping.trackingBody: Carrier labels and tracking numbers are generated via ShipStation and returned to you with the order.
shipping.faultTitle: Production faults: our fault, our fix
shipping.faultBodyBefore: If we misprint, mis-engrave or produce the wrong item, we remake and reship it to your customer free — report it within 30 days with a photo, no physical return needed. Transit loss or damage is a carrier claim; full policy in our

faq.metaDescription: Common questions about white-label print-on-demand with FomaPrint — blind drop-shipping, sending orders, payment, file specs and supported channels.
faq.ogDescription: How white-label POD and blind drop-shipping work with FomaPrint.
faq.lead: The essentials on selling under your brand while we handle production and blind shipping.
faq.a1: You take the order and send it to us; we print and ship to your customer under your brand.
faq.a2: No — blind/white-label; the sender is your brand, no FomaPrint branding or pricing in the package.
faq.a3: Enter orders and upload print files in your seller portal per our file specs (ShipStation automation coming).
faq.a4: You load a prepaid balance (wallet) and orders draw from it — no subscription or monthly fee. Per-unit pricing is quote-based; we send rates when you apply.
faq.a5: High-contrast black artwork on a transparent background (PNG, or vector SVG/PDF), sized to the product's engraving area. We send the full per-product spec sheet with your reseller welcome pack.
faq.a6: Our US print center; made & shipped in the USA.
faq.a7: Yes — many of our resellers sell on Amazon, Etsy and Shopify and route their orders to us for production and blind shipping. We fulfill the order; the listing, storefront and customer stay yours.

about.metaDescription: About FOMA FAMILY LLC — the U.S. print-on-demand and laser-engraving partner behind FomaPrint. You sell it; we personalize, produce and blind-ship it under your brand.
about.ogDescription: The production partner behind your store — made to order in the USA by FOMA FAMILY LLC.
about.lead: {brand} is the print-on-demand and laser-engraving arm of {legal}. Resellers list our products under their own brand; we personalize, produce and blind-ship every order from the USA — so you can sell without holding inventory or running a workshop.
about.value1Body: Every piece is laser-engraved with precision for a crisp, permanent finish — the quality your customers expect from your brand.
about.value2Body: We blind drop-ship from the USA. No FomaPrint logos, no pricing on the slip — only your store reaches your buyer.
about.value3Body: Produced to order in our American studio, so quality, turnaround and capacity stay in our control — and yours.
about.value4Body: From your first order to thousands a month, our production and your seller portal grow with your store.
about.missionP1: FomaPrint is the fulfillment arm of {legal}, a Georgia-based company founded in 2021. We started on the retail side — selling personalized engraved gifts to shoppers on Amazon under our Foma Family brand — and spent years engraving, packing and shipping one-at-a-time orders with our own machines.
about.missionP2: Along the way we kept meeting small online sellers — Etsy shops, boutique brands, corporate-gift resellers — with great products to sell and nowhere dependable to make them. Sourcing, engraving, packing and shipping were eating the hours that should have gone into growing their store.
about.missionP3: So we became the part nobody sees. Today {legal} runs a U.S. studio and a catalog of over {count} personalizable products — drinkware, gifts, frames and office goods — all ready to engrave to order and blind-ship under your brand, with same-day printing and shipping on orders placed before {cutoff} and a same-day reply on every quote request.
about.portalBody: Behind the catalog sits our seller portal — the workspace that routes your orders, tracks production and hands you blind tracking numbers. Seller accounts are open now — apply to get started.
about.ctaTitle: Ready to sell under your brand?
about.ctaBody: Browse the catalog or apply to sell — same-day reply on quotes, same-day printing and shipping on orders placed before {cutoff}.
